items.title: 2 Large-Cap Stocks to Keep an Eye On and 1 Facing Headwinds
items.summary: Large-cap stocks have the power to shape entire industries thanks to their size and widespread influence. With such vast footprints, however, finding new areas for growth is much harder than for smaller, more agile players.

items.title: 2 Industrials Stocks with Exciting Potential and 1 We Ignore
items.summary: Whether you see them or not, industrials businesses play a crucial part in our daily activities. Unfortunately, this role also comes with a demand profile tethered to the ebbs and flows of the broader economy, and the industry is currently lagging as its six-month return of 2.3% has trailed the S&P 500’s 12.9% gain.
